target_customer: P&C insurance carriers, MGAs and brokers whose claims departments run quality assurance reviews
problem: Claims QA samples only a few files per adjuster per month, so leakage, compliance and coverage errors go unnoticed on most claims.
business_model: Enterprise SaaS for continuous claims review integrated with Guidewire and Duck Creek

founders.name: Suril Kantaria
previous_startups: Savvy (co-founder, YC W20, acquired by Take Command)
founders.background_notes: Education from company site bio; the YC page lists none.

founders.name: Kevin Cox
previous_startups: Savvy (co-founder and CTO, YC W20, acquired)

technical_complexity.rationale: LLM agents reading claim files and scoring them against customer scorecards are standard applied AI, but integrating with Guidewire and Duck Creek and meeting SOC 2 adds real engineering.

defensibility.rationale: Deep claims system integrations and carrier-specific scorecards create some lock-in, but the underlying LLM capability is available to all rivals.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Not established; several claims AI startups were funded in 2025 per press, but no incumbent absorbing the wedge was found.

market_need_then: The company cites claims as about 75 percent of every insurance dollar and reviewed by manual sampling; the Reuters-sourced headline reports a 10 million dollar seed and operations with several large MGAs and carriers within about a year.

branding.domain_note: Uses adaptional.com (exact match .com); acquisition history not found.

identity.logo: Simple wordmark with a logo mark, light and dark versions
identity.visual_style: Gray with teal accents, document, shield and checkmark icons

brand_strength.rationale: Clean but generic enterprise identity; no press or community about the brand itself was found.

outcome_analysis: Adaptional, founded by two repeat insurtech founders who previously sold Savvy, raised a reported 10 million dollar seed around its Summer 2025 batch and says its agents already run at large P&C carriers. The thesis rides the shift to agentic AI in claims. It is early, active and unexited, with competition rising from other funded claims AI startups.
notes: The tradingview page could not be opened (404); the 10 million seed is taken from the Reuters headline shown in search plus Caplight and Neuronfeed aggregators. Neuronfeed also lists a 500K January 2025 round, unverified so not recorded. Total raised conflicts (10.05M vs 10.5M). Investors partly from Caplight. YC page says Savvy sold; company bio names Take Command as acquirer. No dated competitor sources were found, only undated aggregator comparison pages naming CLARA Analytics, Liberate, Federato, Qantev, MarvelX and ClaimSorted; later entrants include Avallon and Agentech (late 2025 press).
